scope: Independent frozen-source review of NestedEventArgs and NestedEventCert only; no edits, compiles or Extract review

compile_evidence.status: Parent/author reports targeted exit0; reviewer inspected full persisted logs
compile_evidence.axioms: All printed theorems use only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound

checks: Request.eval is a nonrecursive wrapper around actual X/Xi/Theta/Lambda/step, preserving complete Except outcome types. Step gas refers to pre-Z input; mid/cost are linked by actual successful Z.
Accepted Z supplies actual operand arity and preserves stack; getD operand defaults cannot hide a real recursive invocation. StepArgs.ofGuard binds op and immediate argument to the original decode.

CALL-family step fuel0 has no work; fuel1 reaches helper0 but no Theta child; fuel(n+2) selects Theta n iff actual balance/codeOwner and depth gates pass. CALLCODE recipient/code-target split and DELEGATECALL source/apparentValue versus zero actual transfer are exact. STATICCALL permission is false.

Call arguments retain world, original world, created accounts, blob hashes, header, source/origin, gas price, data slice, depth, access substate and stipend-inclusive Ccallgas before opcode charge. Dispatcher execLength update is included by entered state.

CREATE/CREATE2 step fuel(n+1) select Lambda n after nonce and balance/depth/init-length gates. Includes Lambda0 even though CREATE catches its OutOfFuel; does not erase attempted children when post-child word-gas guard later fails. Charged-state forwarding L, nonce increment, salt and init bytes match evaluator.

Xi wrapper consumes one fuel into X and installs literal fresh machine/jumpdest table; Theta Code consumes one into Xi with actual credit-then-debit world and environment; Lambda preimage branch consumes one into collision-selected init Xi with exact created set, access substate, and debit/insert world.
Precompile and failed-address-encoding wrapper branches have no recursive Xi child; wrapper zero-fuel constructors remain separate. Their no-event trees do not infer successful outcomes.

Cert X constructors cover guard errors, step errors, continue, halt, revert. Step errors retain child tree while no uncompleted local marker is emitted. All successful steps emit exactly their Marked flag, child once and continuation once.

Transparent wrapper constructors require certificate for same actual selected inner invocation and retain tree despite rollback/exception conversion. No arbitrary child-success or gas-bound premise appears.

Cert.sound proves actual outcome equality via literal X inversion and reflexivity for evaluator-indexed wrappers. outcome_deterministic follows two sound equalities; it correctly claims outcome uniqueness, not tree uniqueness.
scope_limits: These two files define selection and certificates; they do not alone export actual total extraction or tree determinism. Those belong to the still-unreviewed Extract snapshot.

Many wrapper/step sound cases are reflexive because constructor conclusions already index actual eval. This is sound outcome indexing, not by itself proof that event selection is complete; checked selection gates/equations plus forthcoming total extraction and tree uniqueness provide that link.
No concrete LOG0-to-append injection, frame ownership grammar, aggregate gas bound, block accounting, funding bound or protocol reachability is claimed by these files.
These certify pinned evaluator semantics, including CREATE caught-error/empty-world behavior, not independent correctness of that evaluator against a chosen EL fork.
